title: CsRTP
description: A Custom RTP Plugin with a GUI making it easy to use!
body:

FEATURES:

- -> A Custom RTP GUI
- -> Everything is Configurable
- -> Custom Permissions
- -> 24/7 Support on our Discord Server



COMMANDS:

- -> /rtp - Teleport to a Random Location
- -> /rtp reload - Reload the Configuration
- -> /rtp help - Send a Help Message



PERMISSION:

- -> csrtp.use - Everyone has it by Default
- -> csrtp.use - Give Admin Features
- -> csrtp.cooldown.bypass -> Bypass the Cooldown
- -> csrtp.delay.bypass -> Bypass the Delay
